labels.M2_bayes_dynamic_hist: Headline forecast: a dynamic Bayesian average of the runoff polls with house effects, plus the historical eve-of-runoff polling error (Datafolha, 2002 to 2022).
labels.M2_as_registered: M2 with the election-day error in the form first registered, which understates the uncertainty of having only six past elections (Deviation 1).
labels.M0_naive_last: The simplest credible baseline: the mean of each pollster's last poll (published from 2026-10-18), plus an election-day error with SD 1.81.
labels.M1_structural: Independent of runoff polls: the first-round result plus transfers of eliminated candidates' voters, cross-switching and turnout noise; narrow by construction, so read its median.
labels.M3_bayes_dynamic_nobias: M2 with no historical bias term (b = 0): how much the history-of-error assumption moves the answer.
labels.M4_bayes_dynamic_hist_r1: M2 with the mean bias also using the 2026 first-round polling error: the "polls missed the right again" scenario.
labels.M5_bayes_dynamic_lv: Turnout scenario: M2 shifted by the mean likely-voter delta the pollsters published, with b = 0 to avoid counting it twice.
labels.M2_established: Exploratory: M2 with house effects centred on the 11 pollsters that have a scorable 2026 first-round final poll (Deviation 2).
